reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the 2 capsules per sachet and the QR code on the box. I stick with Pure Encapsulations, Thorne or Nature Made, and this is a new brand with no reviews and no NSF or USP seal that I can see, so I would not swap my nightly magnesium for it.
